cases.name: built-in worked example
stdout: (no config - demo: three invented creators, a draft contract, and the results after one round)
SHORTLIST - cost per thousand people who fit your buyer
Ops Weekly (newsletter + YouTube) (YouTube): fee 3,000, reach 21,000 views, match 45% - 317 per 1,000 matched (best on this list)
Startup Finance Daily (LinkedIn): fee 4,500, reach 38,000 views, match 20% - 592 per 1,000 matched (1.9x the best on this list)
- 63% of their recent posts are sponsored. Before paying for one, compare how their sponsored posts perform against their own; this engine flags anything above 50%.
- Check three of their past sponsored posts for a clear disclosure placed with the endorsement, not only in a bio or behind "more".
The Bootstrapped CFO (Podcast): fee 2,500, reach 60,000 followers, match - - needs data
! Only a follower count was given. A follower count is not how many people see a post; ask for median views on their last ten posts.
! No audience match share. Ask for the audience breakdown from their platform analytics - location, age, job or industry where available - and count the share that fits your buyer.
CONTRACT - missing terms
! Usage rights: Whether you may reuse the content in ads or on your site, where, and for how long.
! Exclusivity window: Whether they can promote a direct competitor, and for how long.
! If a post is removed or underdelivers: What happens if the post comes down early or a deliverable is missed.
RESULTS - target cost per acquisition 250
Ops Weekly (newsletter + YouTube): 14 tracked + 5 survey mentions; 214 per tracked conversion (158 counting survey mentions)
KEEP: Tracked conversions alone come in at or under target. Keep, and consider a longer arrangement.
Startup Finance Daily: 9 tracked + 12 survey mentions; 500 per tracked conversion (214 counting survey mentions)
RENEGOTIATE: Only hits target if every survey mention is counted as extra. Renegotiate toward a lower fixed fee plus a per-conversion payment, or run once more with a stronger offer.
The Bootstrapped CFO: 1 tracked + 2 survey mentions; 2,500 per tracked conversion (833 counting survey mentions)
TOO-EARLY: Fewer than 5 conversions from tracking and survey combined - too few to judge. This engine treats 5 as the floor.
